Run module 1 first: it saves `data.visits_with_arm`, which this assignment
reads.

```{r}
visits <- data_read("data.visits_with_arm")
```

## Question 1

For each participant, compute the change in weight from their first visit to
their last visit with a weight recorded. The starter code below does this;
read it and explain each step in a sentence.

```{r}
weight_change <- visits |>
  filter(!is.na(weight_kg)) |>
  arrange(participant_id, visit_number) |>
  group_by(participant_id, treatment) |>
  summarise(
    n_weights = n(),
    change_kg = last(weight_kg) - first(weight_kg),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_weights >= 2)

weight_change |>
  group_by(treatment) |>
  summarise(n = n(), mean_change_kg = round(mean(change_kg), 2))
```

## Question 2

Plot the distribution of `change_kg` by arm. Which plot type did you pick and
why?

```{r}
ggplot(weight_change, aes(treatment, change_kg)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Weight change (kg)")
```

## Question 3

Is the difference between arms larger than you'd expect by chance? Run a test
and write two sentences on what it does and doesn't tell you.

```{r}
t.test(change_kg ~ treatment, data = weight_change)
```
